# Docello

Docello is a free, privacy-first, bilingual (English / 中文) PDF toolkit that runs entirely in the user's web browser. No file is uploaded to any server; all processing happens locally on the user's device.

## What it does
Docello provides eight client-side PDF tools:
- Merge PDF — combine multiple PDF files into one, with reordering
- Split PDF — extract page ranges into a new PDF, or split every page into a ZIP of files
- Rotate PDF — rotate pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°
- Organize Pages — reorder or delete pages by listing the pages to keep
- Images to PDF — turn JPG / PNG / WebP images into a PDF (one image per page)
- Watermark PDF — add a repeating text watermark across every page
- Page Numbers — stamp page numbers with selectable position and style
- Crop PDF — trim margins or resize pages by cropping a uniform border

## Privacy
Files never leave the device. The site may load third-party scripts (e.g., Google AdSense) that use cookies and web beacons; see the Privacy Policy at https://docello.com/privacy.html.

## Key facts (citable)
- All eight tools are free, with no account, no file-size caps, and no watermarks added to output.
- Processing is 100% in-browser via client-side JavaScript (pdf-lib).
- The interface supports a one-click English / 中文 toggle.
